title: Universal Weather Node — history (/api/history?range=24h|7d|30d|1y)
description: History as parallel arrays, oldest first: element i of every value array belongs to ageSec[i]. Three tiers on the node: 5-min buckets (288 = 24 h), 1-h buckets (840 = 35 days) and local calendar days (731 = 2 years). range picks the window length, end (unix seconds) moves its end into the past (compare periods), res forces a tier; by default the finest tier that reaches back to end − range serves it (/api/info history). Points are the buckets whose end lies in (end − range, end]; ranges with more than 400 buckets are downsampled on the node (30d: 2-h points; see bucketSec). Buckets are fixed windows (wall clock once synced, else uptime; days: local midnight to midnight, 23 or 25 h at the DST changes), one point per window, a cycle counts in the window it ends in. Only at end = now: the last element with ageSec 0 is the still-open bucket (a live preview). null = no data in that bucket (sensor off/absent, node off, or no cycle in that window when cycles are longer than the bucket) — draw a gap, never a 0. All arrays and unit fields are always present (empty arrays when the window holds no bucket). Kept across restarts (flash). Stability: within apiVersion 1 fields are only added.

range.description: The range served (an unknown range parameter gives 24h).

res.description: Tier the points come from: 5-min, hourly or daily buckets.

bucketSec.description: Nominal length of one point: the tier's bucket times the number of buckets merged per point (daily: 86400, real days 82800–90000 at the DST changes).

items.description: Seconds between the end of the bucket and this response.

ageSec.description: Age of every point's end, decreasing (oldest first) in steps of bucketSec (a day of 23/25 h at the DST changes; where points were merged, the end of the newest bucket in it). Timestamp of point i = time of your request − ageSec[i]; it covers the bucketSec before that.

windGust.description: Highest gust per point (maximum, not mean).

windDirDeg.description: Last valid wind direction in the point (degrees from north; not averaged).

rainMm.description: Rain amount per point (sum — add them up for totals). Despite the name in rainUnit (in when imperial).

temp.description: Mean air temperature per point (daily / merged: mean of the hourly or bucket means) (selected source).

tempMin.description: Lowest air temperature per point (lowest cycle value; daily: the day's minimum).

tempMax.description: Highest air temperature per point (highest cycle value; daily: the day's maximum).

humMin.description: Lowest relative humidity per point (lowest cycle value; daily: the day's minimum).

humMax.description: Highest relative humidity per point (highest cycle value; daily: the day's maximum).

pressureQnh.description: Mean sea-level pressure per point (selected pressure source).

pressMin.description: Lowest sea-level pressure (QNH) per point (lowest cycle value; daily: the day's minimum).

pressMax.description: Highest sea-level pressure (QNH) per point (highest cycle value; daily: the day's maximum).

uvSensorVolts.description: Mean board UV sensor voltage per point (V4 Full).

uvIndex.description: Mean UV index per point (wireless or calibrated board input).

ds18b20_0.description: Mean temperature of DS18B20 probe slot 0 (= /api/data ds18b20[0]).

ds18b20_1.description: Mean temperature of DS18B20 probe slot 1.

ds18b20_2.description: Mean temperature of DS18B20 probe slot 2.

tempUnit.description: Unit of temp, tempMin, tempMax and ds18b20_*.

pressureUnit.description: Unit of pressureQnh, pressMin and pressMax.

series.description: Custom series (Settings -> Sensors -> Custom series), one object per defined series; values aligned with ageSec. Temperatures in tempUnit.
series.x-present: only with at least one custom series

slot.description: Slot number on the settings page (also in {series_<slot>}, /api/data and Home Assistant).

agg.description: How cycles are combined into a bucket, hours into a day and buckets into a downsampled point: the value's default (lightning strikes sum, storm distance min, else mean) unless set for the series.

unit.description: Unit of the values; absent if none (e.g. lightning strikes, UV index).

sensor.description: Internal ID of the logical (★) wireless sensor the series follows; absent for a board probe.

perBucket.description: true = a sum per point (agg sum, e.g. lightning strikes), not a level; the range total is their sum.

values.description: One value per bucket, aligned with ageSec; null = no value.
